newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Snia shares rise on Rhone interest.
newsitem.headline: Italy Snia shares rise on Rhone interest.

text.p: Shares in Italian chemical firm Snia Fibre and its controlling Snia Bpd rose on the Milan bourse on reported buying interest from France's Rhone-Poulenc, traders said.
Snia Bpd and Fibre are part of the Fiat group which last week announced plans to merge Fibre into Bpd this year.
At 1050 GMT, Snia Bpd was up 2.04 percent at 1,805 lire after a high of 1,855 on a weak stock market. Snia Fibre was 2.44 percent higher at 709 lire after an early high at 710.

Rhone Chairman Jean-Rene Fourtou said in an interview with financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore he was happy with Rhone's join nylon venture with Snia Fibre and aimed for a strategic long-term presence in the sector.

"The situation could develop but it is up to Fiat to take the initiative. We do not intend to purchase the whole of Snia but for the rest we are open to any proposal.... What matters is the cost," Fourtou was quoted as saying. --Milan newsroom +392 66129589
